primitives.name: Uncertainty Quantification via Resampling
primitives.verbatim_quote: 3 Uncertainty Estimation Consider a player with fixed ability and repeat the same season for that player many times.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'RAA': 'Relative Added Average, dimensionless', 'WAR': 'Wins Above Replacement, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Player ability is fixed; outcomes vary due to stochasticity in playing events.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When player events are independent and identically distributed.

layer2.mapping: Resampling generates empirical distributions over RAA/WAR; enables GSI uncertainty quantification and GSE probabilistic forecasting.
layer2.telemetry: Standard deviation of simulated RAA/WAR across 1000 seasons.

primitives.name: Resampling Strategy for Run Adjustment
primitives.verbatim_quote: For a particular season, we resample (with replacement) individual balls, fit the regression model for adjusting run values, and use the adjusted run values for new RAA and WAR values for individual players.
primitives.assumptions: Regression model accurately reflects run value adjustments; resampling preserves event correlations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When event-level data is sufficient and correlated.

layer2.mapping: Event-level resampling mirrors real-world variability; maps to GSE state transition dynamics and GSI inference kernels.
layer2.telemetry: Mean and variance of adjusted run values post-resampling.
